title: Viral RNA Extraction Protocol Optimized for SARS-CoV-2
author: Alejandro Caro-Quintero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bggvjtw6

steps.title: Dilute 100 µL of the sample...
steps.instruction: Dilute 100 µL of the sample in 300 µL of Saline Solution [ 0.8 Mass / % volume , vortex mix 00:00:10 . Use only 100 µL of this dilution to star protocol. In step 2.3 add 540 µL isopropanol after incubation.

steps.title: To 100 µL of GITC buffer add 12
steps.instruction: To 100 µL of GITC buffer add 12.5 µL of Proteinase K 20 mg/mL ], 200 µL of the sample and mix by vortex for 00:00:10 .

steps.title: Incubate the sample for 00:10:00 at...
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample for 00:10:00 at 60 °C , vortexing every 00:02:00 .

steps.title: Place the tube in a rack...
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a rack and add 270 µL of Isopropanol and 40 µL of magnetic beads (see preparation below). Mix by inverting 8 times.

steps.title: Place the tube (s) in the...
steps.instruction: Place the tube (s) in the magnetic rack for 00:10:00 without moving.

steps.title: Without moving the tube from the...
steps.instruction: Without moving the tube from the magnetic rack, withdraw approximately 610 µL of the solution

steps.title: Without moving the tube from the...
steps.instruction: Without moving the tube from the magnetic rack, add 150 µL of Isopropanol and wait 30 seconds and remove the isopropanol from the tube.

steps.title: Without moving the tube from the...
steps.instruction: Without moving the tube from the magnetic rack, add 200 µL of 70 % (v/v) Ethanol, and remove from the tube.

steps.title: Without moving the tube from the...
steps.instruction: Without moving the tube from the magnetic rack, repeat previous washing 2.7 and extract the Ethanol to the maximum.

steps.title: Without moving the tube from the...
steps.instruction: Without moving the tube from the magnetic rack, allow drying for approximately 00:05:00 .

steps.title: Add 30 µL l of molecular...
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL l of molecular grade water to the tube trying to discharge the liquid on top of the tube walls where the beads are located.

steps.title: Remove the tube from the magnetic...
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic rack and vortex 00:00:10 to allow the beads to enter the solution and incubate 00:01:00 at room temperature in a normal rack

steps.title: Place the tube back in the...
steps.instruction: Place the tube back in the magnetic rack and for 00:03:00 to 00:05:00 , and transfer 20 µL of the bead-free elution to a new tube and store at -80 °C .
